chart.definition: Cap-init time t=i*0.5 M; fixed phase-zero cap states, fixed physical scale, no time/phase fit.
chart.old_map_interpolation: Independent natural cubic on source corrected Re/Im; exact comparison uses output samples only.
chart.old_map_rule: The legacy low-endpoint formula labeled source index i at exact time minus delta; querying it at native t samples the exact source spline at t+delta.

limitations: The old-map shift is a deliberate chart error; the established peak-aligned waveform used independent sampled-mode anchors and did not rely on the old low-endpoint formula.
Raw same-state and own-state controls were captured by an earlier refined cap trajectory, not by this full-mode run; exact full-series replay is the bridge.
Native-defined NQC-local and post-boundary windows do not identify source NQC or attachment times; their residuals are descriptive, not causal component isolation.
Source raw*NQC reconstruction is a separate source-formula control. A failure remains a finding and does not alter corrected-mode chart metrics.
